units.rawText: My first encounter with Professor, from my records occurred on the borders of the Oasis. Though at the time, I was about to faint...
units.displayText: My first encounter with Professor, from my records occurred on the borders of the Oasis. Though at the time, I was about to faint...

spans.text: My first encounter with Professor, from my records occurred on the borders of the Oasis. Though at the time, I was about to faint...

units.rawText: I was wandering about with no purpose after awakening from the Neural Cocoon. I couldn't enter the sectors I passed by, nor could I find my way back to the Neural Cloud Sector. The only "company" I had were the Sanctifiers, who relentlessly chased and attacked me... I was terrified and on the verge of tears...

spans.text: I was wandering about with no purpose after awakening from the Neural Cocoon. I couldn't enter the sectors I passed by, nor could I find my way back to the Neural Cloud Sector. The only "company" I had were the Sanctifiers, who relentlessly chased and attacked me... I was terrified and on the verge of tears...

units.rawText: When I had nowhere else to turn, I sent out my last balloon, hoping someone would see it. But honestly, I didn't hold much faith at that time.
units.displayText: When I had nowhere else to turn, I sent out my last balloon, hoping someone would see it. But honestly, I didn't hold much faith at that time.

spans.text: When I had nowhere else to turn, I sent out my last balloon, hoping someone would see it. But honestly, I didn't hold much faith at that time.

units.rawText: But then hope appeared—you were there when I opened my eyes again. I still remember the worry in your eyes. You comforted me, telling me not to be scared, and I couldn't have been happier in that moment.

units.rawText: Professor, do you still remember this balloon? This is the one I sent out back then.
units.displayText: Professor, do you still remember this balloon? This is the one I sent out back then.

spans.text: Professor, do you still remember this balloon? This is the one I sent out back then.

units.rawText: Mai holds a weather balloon with both hands. Its age is evident, but so is the care and effort Mai has put into maintaining it.
units.displayText: Mai holds a weather balloon with both hands. Its age is evident, but so is the care and effort Mai has put into maintaining it.

spans.text: Mai holds a weather balloon with both hands. Its age is evident, but so is the care and effort Mai has put into maintaining it.

units.rawText: Is this information helpful to you, Professor? If it's not enough... I-I still have the balloons Professor gifted to me, and the notes from your scouting instructions, and tactical map sketches... Ah, and the weather simulator...

spans.text: Is this information helpful to you, Professor? If it's not enough... I-I still have the balloons Professor gifted to me, and the notes from your scouting instructions, and tactical map sketches... Ah, and the weather simulator...

units.rawText: Hehehe, I didn't think you'd take notes on scouting.
units.displayText: Hehehe, I didn't think you'd take notes on scouting.

spans.text: Hehehe, I didn't think you'd take notes on scouting.

units.rawText: Professor, you once said that knowledge would help us escape the Cloud, so I recorded everything I could. Does that make Mai... helpful to you, Professor?

units.rawText: The information you just gave me, Mai, and your scouting reports have always been incredibly helpful. Thank you, Mai.
